Title: Supporting Experiential Learning Opportunities for Students with Disabilities

Authors: Aquino, Katherine C., Plump, Carolyn

Publication Information: Journal of College Student Development, v63 n3 p255-268 May-June 2022

Abstract: Limited research has explored the experiences of disability resource professionals who support students with disabilities (SWDs) in accessing experiential learning outside the classroom environment. This study uses an explanatory sequential mixed methods approach to investigate whether and how accommodations are provided to and used by SWDs during experiential learning opportunities. Findings indicate that many higher education institutions prioritize the classroom needs of SWDs over their other academic needs. Themes identified through a national survey and qualitative interviews emphasize the importance of providing additional support for SWDs outside the classroom.

Keywords: Students with Disabilities, Experiential Learning, Accessibility, College Students, Student Needs, Barriers, College Faculty, Administrators, Misconceptions, Training, Teacher Role, Administrator Role, Knowledge Level.

DOI: 10.1353/csd.2022.0022

This record provides metadata about the scholarly article "Supporting Experiential Learning Opportunities for Students with Disabilities" published in the Journal of College Student Development by authors Katherine C. Aquino and Carolyn Plump. The article investigates the experiences of disability resource professionals supporting students with disabilities in accessing experiential learning opportunities outside the classroom. The findings suggest that there is a lack of attention given to these students' needs beyond the traditional classroom setting, and themes emerge regarding the necessity of providing additional support. Keywords associated with this record include students with disabilities, experiential learning, accessibility, college students, student needs, barriers, college faculty, administrators, misconceptions, training, teacher role, and administrator role.
